{
  "opening_spine": {
    "pressure_source_type": "moral",
    "pressure_source": "Seren is abandoning the rehearsed wish in front of the whole assembly and spending her First Sacrifice on Lirael instead, blurring the wording so as not to name the wound aloud",
    "hook_object": null,
    "opening_beat": "Seren’s voice falters mid-invocation, her hands trembling as she glances at Lirael instead of the Dohkar’s waiting gaze",
    "rising_beats": [
      "The presiding Dohkar’s posture shifts—his fingers tightening around his ceremonial sash, a silent signal to Seren to correct herself",
      "Lirael’s muffled breath hitches behind the cloth tied across her mouth, her pulse hammering against the band’s edge"
    ],
    "decision_beat": "Should she let Seren’s unspoken wish twist the rite—or tear the cloth away and risk the assembly’s judgment?",
    "pc_career": "Sacrificiant",
    "opening_setting": "Veilwood ceremony clearing",
    "environment_elements": [
      "the frayed edge of the deep-crimson spiralgrass carpet where Seren’s bare feet press",
      "the pale mated-pair trees’ leaf-curtains trembling in the dawn breeze"
    ],
    "interlocutor_placement": "the presiding Dohkar — the senior officiant who trained Seren, his silver-streaked braid pulled taut against his collarbone, always correcting with a single raised eyebrow",
    "pc_self_presentation_beat": "Lirael’s fingers twitch toward the cloth across her mouth, then still—her first instinct to speak, to fix this, but the band muffles even the thought.",
    "scene_want": "She wants Seren to name the wound clearly, even if it means breaking the rite’s rules",
    "scene_mission": "Stop Seren’s wish from twisting before the presiding Dohkar calls for the cost to be spoken aloud",
    "reader_state": {
      "knows": "Seren is abandoning the rehearsed wish to sacrifice for Lirael instead, and the presiding Dohkar is watching closely",
      "believes": "The rite’s alignment is already breaking, and Lirael must act before the Dohkar intervenes",
      "wondering": "What will Seren’s unspoken wish cost Lirael?",
      "must_not_confuse": "The cloth across Lirael’s mouth is only protocol, not a spell; tearing it won’t release any force"
    },
    "pc_body_callback": "opening — stress_tic (the grandmother’s ring)",
    "li_body_callback": "beat 2 — focus_tell (the Dohkar’s gaze locking onto Seren’s hands)",
    "staged_characters": [
      {
        "name": "Lirael",
        "presence": "IN_PERSON",
        "anchor_beat": "FROM_PC_OPENING_FUSION"
      },
      {
        "name": "Julian",
        "presence": "IN_PERSON",
        "anchor_beat": "FROM_CHARACTER_PLUS"
      },
      {
        "name": "Seren",
        "presence": "IN_PERSON",
        "anchor_beat": "FROM_CHARACTER_PLUS"
      },
      {
        "name": "the presiding Dohkar",
        "presence": "IN_PERSON",
        "anchor_beat": "FROM_CHARACTER_PLUS"
      }
    ]
  },
  "scene_skeleton": {
    "character_plus": [
      {
        "character": "Seren",
        "mode": "IN_PERSON",
        "option_id": "OPT-4",
        "expression_mode": "LEAK",
        "first_mention": true,
        "visible_action": "Seren’s hands hover over the spiralgrass, fingers twitching as if reaching for something unseen—then she presses them flat, smoothing the braids instead of naming the wound aloud",
        "behavior_object_ids": ["O3"],
        "behavior_person_ids": [],
        "revelation_bridge": "Her avoidance of direct naming reveals she believes softening the wound is kinder than making it plain.",
        "pc_lens_operation": "INWARD_TRANSLATION_OF_ANOTHER_PERSONS_COST",
        "pc_interpretation": "Seren is shielding Lirael’s wound by blurring it, even at the cost of the rite’s alignment."
      },
      {
        "character": "the presiding Dohkar",
        "mode": "IN_PERSON",
        "option_id": "OPT-8",
        "expression_mode": "CONTRADICT",
        "first_mention": true,
        "visible_action": "The Dohkar’s fingers tighten around his ceremonial sash, then relax—his usual correction delayed, his gaze lingering on Seren’s hands instead of her face",
        "behavior_object_ids": ["O5"],
        "behavior_person_ids": ["named:seren"],
        "revelation_bridge": "His hesitation to intervene reveals he assumes his judgment carries authority others haven’t earned.",
        "pc_lens_operation": "EMOTIONAL_CONCLUSION_BEFORE_EVIDENCE",
        "pc_interpretation": "The Dohkar is judging Seren’s sacrifice too small for what’s being asked, but he won’t voice it."
      }
    ],
    "environment_plus": {
      "target": "the deep-crimson carpet of braided mated-pair spiralgrass",
      "axis": "use",
      "beat": "The grass’s braids are worn smooth where Seren’s bare feet have pressed, but the frayed edges near Lirael’s position remain untouched—no one else has stood there."
    },
    "pc_opening_fusion": {
      "character": "Lirael",
      "placement": "PC_FIRST_EMBODIED_BEAT",
      "character_angle": "Her first instinct is to fix this, but the cloth across her mouth muffles even the thought—she’s trapped between protocol and the rite’s breaking alignment.",
      "environment_target": "the deep-crimson carpet of braided mated-pair spiralgrass",
      "environment_axis": "use",
      "beat": "Lirael’s bare toes sink into the spiralgrass’s frayed edges, her weight shifting as she watches Seren’s hands hover over the braids."
    }
  }
